global_sequence_description: Surveillance footage of a grocery aisle where a synthetic subject inspects a boxed product and returns it to the shelf.

chronological_sequence_segments.scene_description: The subject stands in the middle of the aisle wearing a jacket, holding a small blue-and-white product box in both hands and inspecting the front label.
The subject looks toward the shelving unit on their right, extends their right arm holding the box, and places the item back into its designated spot at chest height.
The subject releases the box, drops their right arm back down to their side, turns away from the shelf, and begins to walk forward.
